messages:
Jordan (AE): quick summary from yesterday's call — need alignment on scope for the Acme trial: 3-week run, SDK integration, auth model, quotas/rate limits, streaming behavior, retry semantics, telemetry/metrics, and acceptance criteria. can SE/devex confirm feasibility?
Priya (SE): yes we can support a 3-week trial. proposed milestones: week 1 - auth + basic integration + sample prompts; week 2 - load/throughput and eval runs; week 3 - quality tuning + cost/report. need expected qps and max sequence length from Acme.
Evan - Acme (POC lead): expected peak ~10 qps, avg ~3 qps. typical sequences up to ~1024 tokens. acceptance criteria: p95 latency < 300ms, uptime >= 95% during tests, and quality >= baseline on 100 eval prompts.
Alex M. (Sales Eng): for hosted plan we'll suggest a soft quota at 20 qps and token caps during POC. if they want customer-managed keys or VPC peering that's Dedicated/Private pricing. streaming support: we have chunked streaming (HTTP SSE + websockets) — fine for progressive UI. retries: recommend idempotency token; server will dedupe if token provided.
Marta (DevEx): sharing a quick SDK snippet that mirrors what we'll ask Acme to run in week1:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.generate(model="open-lite", input="Summarize the following...", stream=False)
print(resp.text)
```
also will share a streaming example and a small test harness they can run locally.
Sam (Security): security checklist from our side: SOC2 attestation available, can support IP allowlist and audit logging. for CMK/KMS we require Dedicated or Private deployment; hosted can do transient keys for POC. retention: logs retained 180 days by default, can extend for enterprise. need their security questionnaire — will draft answers.
Evan - Acme (POC lead): CMK is preferred long term, but POC ok with ephemeral keys if we can validate encryption-in-transit and at-rest. we can circulate the questionnaire today. also confirm: are streaming sessions tied to a single connection or token? we do session affinity for some UI features.
Priya (SE): streaming sessions are bound to the connection; we support reconnect semantics and resume from partial state using KV cache tokens. session affinity is supported via routing key. will document reconnect & retry patterns.
Jordan (AE): action items: Priya -> integration runbook + sample prompts by Tue 09:00 PT; Alex -> soft quotas & a POC pricing note by EOD Mon; Sam -> initial security QA answers by Tue; Marta -> SDK quickstart + streaming examples today; Evan -> share the 100 eval prompts and confirm CMK requirement by EOD Mon.
Evan - Acme (POC lead): ack, will share prompts + questionnaire responses by EOD Mon.
Marta (DevEx): dropping a link to the sample repo and a small curl example for auth: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Priya (SE): note on quotas/limits: we will set rate limit headers and return 429 with `Retry-After`. advise client-side backoff with jitter. for idempotent calls include `Idempotency-Key`.
Jordan (AE): scheduling a 1-week checkpoint — calendar-bot will invite folks for 30m next Wed. :thumbsup:
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Acme POC checkpoint — Wed 10:00 PT (30m)
Sam (Security): one more ask — Acme, please indicate required data residency region (EU/US) in the questionnaire so we can route logs and backups appropriately.
Evan - Acme (POC lead): will mark EU in the questionnaire. thanks everyone, this is helpful.
Jordan (AE): great — closing thread for now, we'll post runbook + links once shared. :rocket:
